title: few-shot-cot template variables
description: Values for templates/few-shot-cot.md.j2 and templates/few-shot-cot.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from few-shot-cot.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

actual_input.title: Actual input
actual_input.description: What is the input to solve? The eval runner substitutes one case per invocation; fill it by hand only when rendering the prompt for a single case.

example_1_answer.title: Example 1 answer
example_1_answer.description: What is the final answer for the first example, in exactly the form you want back?

example_1_input.title: Example 1 input
example_1_input.description: What is the first worked example's input? Pick one that exercises the reasoning shape you want copied, not the easiest case you have.

example_1_reasoning_steps.title: Example 1 reasoning steps
example_1_reasoning_steps.description: What are the reasoning steps for that first example, written the way you want the model to write them? This is the actual instruction - the prose above only frames it.

example_2_answer.title: Example 2 answer
example_2_answer.description: What is the final answer for the second example?

example_2_input.title: Example 2 input
example_2_input.description: What is the second worked example's input? Make it differ from the first in the dimension the model gets wrong, or the second example teaches nothing.

example_2_reasoning_steps.title: Example 2 reasoning steps
example_2_reasoning_steps.description: What are the reasoning steps for that second example?
